subject.title: fix(doctor): bound session snapshot store reads with size cap

question: Should `openclaw doctor` treat all valid session snapshot stores over 16 MiB as unsupported for snapshot scanning and repair, with warning-only recovery?
rationale: The cap resolves the unbounded allocation risk but intentionally changes upgrade behavior for existing stores above the threshold; source-level correctness cannot determine the repository’s supported-size policy.

options.title: Approve the 16 MiB operational ceiling
options.body: Accept warning-and-skip behavior for larger stores because it prevents doctor from allocating unbounded session-store input.

options.title: Preserve large-store repair capability
options.body: Ask for a bounded recovery approach that still lets doctor diagnose or repair legitimate stores above the chosen threshold.

recommendation.title: Approve the 16 MiB operational ceiling
recommendation.body: Accept warning-and-skip behavior for larger stores because it prevents doctor from allocating unbounded session-store input.
